EN.name: Confused
EN.description: Your thoughts are a jumble. You struggle to make sense of the words on a page.

CN.name: 混乱
CN.description: 你的思绪乱成一团，连书页上的字句也读不进去。

EN.name: Troubled
EN.description: Unwelcome memories keep coming back. You struggle to keep your mind on what you are doing.

CN.name: 心乱
CN.description: 那些记忆总在脑海里打转，让你难以专心做事。

EN.name: Dazed
EN.description: Your thoughts keep wandering. It takes an effort to concentrate.

CN.name: 恍惚
CN.description: 你时常走神，要费些力气才能集中精神。

EN.name: Unsettled
EN.description: What you have seen still troubles you, but you can keep your mind on what you are doing.

CN.name: 动摇
CN.description: 那些经历仍让你不安，但你还能专心做事。

EN.name: Clear-headed
EN.description: You can put your worries aside and think clearly.

CN.name: 清醒
CN.description: 你能暂时放下心事，头脑也清楚了许多。

EN.name: Lucid
EN.description: Your mind is clear. You find it easy to concentrate.

CN.name: 清明
CN.description: 你的头脑清晰，很容易集中精神。
